title: The problem Golmet solves
html:
The problem Golmet solves

Your requirements live in a document that nobody re-reads. The specs became a diagram drawn at the start of the project and never updated again. The code ships however it can, and when someone asks "why did this feature ship like this?", the answer is "ask the analyst, they decided — I think". Three months later, even the analyst doesn't remember.

The worst part isn't losing the requirement. It's that nobody trusts the documentation anymore — it's always stale, always incomplete, always somewhere else. So the team stops writing it, and the knowledge leaves when the person leaves.

Golmet exists for that: to make documentation the trustworthy part of the project again — because it is machine-verified against what the code actually does, on every validation, before any merge.
